game_1.title: Crystal Grid Cascade
game_1.prompt: Build a 100% original, commercial-grade, ultra-juicy 8x8 Block Puzzle mobile game in Godot 4.7.2 inspired by public player reviews of Block Blast. Include smooth drag-and-drop and tap-to-place controls, live ghost preview, glowing row/column clear cascades, combo multipliers, Juggle Hold swap slot, Hammer 3x3 smash booster, 30 progressive levels + Endless mode, glossy 3D-style bevelled jewel blocks, musical marimba SFX, zero clipped UI text, and fair offline-safe AdMob + IAP hooks.

game_2.title: Hexa Bolt Craft
game_2.prompt: Build a 100% original, commercial-grade Screw & Layered Plate Puzzle mobile game in Godot 4.7.2 inspired by public player reviews of Screw Jam. Include color-matched screw removal, layered metallic/wood plates with falling physics feedback, active toolbox slots + temporary buffer slots, Drill and Magnet boosters, 30 progressive handcrafted levels, tactile sound effects, zero clipped UI text across 12 mobile screens, and fair offline-safe AdMob + IAP hooks.
